Wildfires in the Okanagan have forced thousands to flee, including migrant workers and care home residents. Emergency services are providing food, shelter, and logistical support while firefighting aircraft battle the blaze.

Community solidarity is high, with local food banks and volunteers providing essential care to those who lost their homes or livelihoods.
